run_xfail_suggester: run the xfail suggester script to parse pytest output and generate xfail suggestions
get_failed_test: extract the test name from a pytest FAILED line using regex matching
get_suggested_xfails: generate xfail or skip entries for failed functorch tests by base category
parse_base: parse a test name into its torch namespace, api name, and variant components
parse_namespace: map a test name prefix to its corresponding torch module namespace like nn.functional
